description: Build a self-contained animated / kinetic typography layer — a word or line that flashes, pulses, or slides, the signature live-VJ lyric-flash effect. A Text TOP renders the text; an LFO CHOP at the given Rate (Hz) drives the animation: 'flash' gates a Level TOP's alpha/opacity hard on/off (a square wave — the text vanishes between flashes rather than turning black, so it pops cleanly in and out over a background), 'pulse' drives a Transform TOP's scale plus a Level TOP alpha fade (a sine, the text breathes), and 'slide' scrolls the Transform TOP's translate-X. Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path` holding the Text TOP, the LFO, the per-mode Transform/Level nodes, an optional Composite, and a Null output. With an input_path the text is composited OVER that source (pulled in by a Select TOP, so it can live in another container); without one it animates on a transparent frame. Rate is free-running for v1 — bind the LFO's frequency to a beat CHOP (or a Trigger to a detect_onsets channel) to lock the flashes to the tempo. This is for a single animated word/line; for a static caption or title use create_text_overlay, and for multi-line scrolling tickers/credits rolls/typewriter reveals use create_text_crawl. Returns a summary plus a JSON block with the container path, created node paths, the text/lfo/output paths, exposed controls, any node errors, warnings, and an inline preview image.

color.description: Text colour as a hex string ('#ffffff' = white). Sets the Text TOP's fontcolorr/g/b.

expose_controls.description: When true (default), expose live Text / Size / Color / Rate controls bound to the right node parameters.

input_path.description: Optional absolute path of a source TOP to lay the text OVER. Pulled in via a Select TOP (TD wires don't cross containers) and composited under the text. If omitted, the text animates on a transparent frame.

mode.description: Animation style: 'flash' = hard on/off blink (a square LFO gates the alpha/opacity — the classic lyric-flash, the text vanishes between flashes rather than going black); 'pulse' = breathing scale-up + alpha fade driven by a sine LFO; 'slide' = the text scrolls horizontally across the frame.

parent_path.description: Parent network where the kinetic-text container is created (default '/project1').

rate_hz.description: Animation rate in cycles per second (Hz) — the LFO frequency. Free-running for v1; bind it to a beat CHOP to fire on the actual beat.

size.description: Font size in pixels (drives the Text TOP's fontsizex / fontsizey).

text.description: The word or line to animate (the lyric flash). Rendered by a Text TOP. For multiple lines use \n.

name: create_kinetic_text
title: Create kinetic text
